browserObservations.method: Chrome browser tool: read existing homepage song link and existing media tab; independently opened API in a new tab. Manual transcription, not a HAR or complete browser network trace.
browserObservations.interpretation: Browser-side HTTPS upgrade is indicated. The exact internal rule (automatic HTTPS upgrades, HSTS, cached redirect, extension) was not captured.
browserObservations.limitation: Browser security policy blocks chrome://net-internals/#hsts; no policy/settings changes or bypass attempted.

timeNormalization: T+seconds relative to the earliest capture timestamp in this file. Not comparable to relative times in other files. Calendar dates remain for study identification.
